scope: Two synthetic host-Mesa controls; captured geometry prototype through public render_svg_pages_pdf. No public BrushPen production dispatch, device, or saved-note parity. Resvg SVG compared to PDFium and MuPDF at 1x, 2x and 4x; native comparison only 1x.
phase_support_definition: RGB differs from normalized background by more than two in any channel. MuPDF background normalized to 252. MAE uses union support. Native frame is premultiplied RGBA composited on 252.
limitations: Mask ablations change image and do not isolate one exact conversion defect.
Replacing soft coverage with hard clip loses the fade and worsens native accuracy.
Moving fade into source before nonlinear filter triggered resvg 0.47.0 composite dimension assertion; not evaluated further.
A half-output-pixel global translation is renderer and scale dependent and is not an admitted fix.
Scripts and JSON results are under ignored tmp; scripts use existing local Python environment and shared prebuilt helper.
